correctness.rationale: Legendre yields ν2(F(j))=2s2(j), and ν2(binomial(3n,n))=2s2(n)-s2(3n). Thus each positive rational normalized summand Q_n,k has exact valuation t+2c with t=s2(3n), c=s2(k)+s2(n-k)-s2(n), the number of binary carries. Guo 2013 Theorem1.2 supplies termwise ordinary integrality. Exactly 2^{s2(n)} k are carry-free submasks; k↔n-k pairs them, and even n central k=n/2 is never carry-free because its carry count equals s2(n)>=1. Pair contributions at exact valuation t+1 are odd when normalized, while other contributions have larger valuation. Therefore s_n/2^{t+1}≡2^{s2(n)-1} (mod2), yielding ν2(s_2^r)=3 and ν2(s_n)>=s2(3n)+2 otherwise; since s2(3n)>=2, the stated n>=1 mod16 dichotomy follows. Endpoints n=1 and k=0,n are included. Independently computed convolution for n=1..33 confirms integer quotients, valuation bounds and mod16; finite check is not the proof.
residual_risks: Relies on Guo theorem only for integrality; 2-adic valuation arithmetic is direct.
No exact ν2(s_n) claimed for arbitrary nonpowers of two or for odd primes.
